note: Research backlog, not implementation evidence. Each mission must progress through hypothesis, prototype, benchmark, review, and documented result.

missions.title: Build unified model orchestration layer
missions.goal: One API for local models, authorized free providers, deterministic tools, quotas, handoff, and provenance.
acceptance: No paid call possible under $0 policy

missions.title: Persistent memory and knowledge graph benchmark
missions.goal: Evaluate memory retrieval and continuity across long tasks and restarts.
acceptance: Facts, hypotheses, decisions, and plans typed separately

missions.title: Agentic software engineering sandbox
missions.goal: Agents propose, test, benchmark, review, and roll back changes safely.
acceptance: Human approval for protected production actions

missions.title: Multi-agent collaboration experiment
missions.goal: Measure when independent specialist agents improve outcomes over one model.

missions.title: Research-to-publication pipeline
missions.goal: Turn approved experiments into explainers, reproducible demos, and benchmark cards.

missions.title: GhostCorp AI Academy first course
missions.goal: Publish a safe course on durable AI task continuity and local model handoff.

missions.title: World-model and VR research sandbox
missions.goal: Use isolated simulations to study spatial planning and agent coordination.
acceptance: VR demo separated from private business systems

missions.title: Original contribution and prior-art program
missions.goal: Identify one concrete unsolved problem, survey prior art, and run a falsifiable experiment.

missions.title: Seamless offline continuity drill
missions.goal: Prove a mission survives internet loss, provider quota exhaustion, process restart, and model switch.

missions.title: Research quality and claim ledger
missions.goal: Track every public technical claim to evidence and current limitations.
